numeric_experiment.hypothesis: ME cannot be a metrological multiplier because HT24 represents45 standard wool units
numeric_experiment.design: Conditional necessary lower bounds under explicitly lossless balance, followed by yield sensitivity; no corpus significance or linguistic probability. Negative residual disproves only the lossless numeric model.

ME_scenarios.qualification: Countermodel takes doubtful a3/a4 glyphs as not ME and allows damaged first and third entries not to carry ME; does not assert those absences.
Includes ME? next to6; missing quantity after ME? in a4 kept nonnegative.
Explicit stronger restoration, not observed text.

assumptions: Fixed45-input balance requires lossless common-batch equivalence, no additions, no processing loss, no different unit conversion; same batch alone is insufficient.
AB118 second occurrence accepted despite published uncertainty
Unpreserved numeric parts contribute nonnegative quantities
Mapping45nearby noduli to45standard input units is itself an assumption; loss-based alternative may require a different token role.
numeric_experiment.independent_evidence: Numeric marks and nearby nodulus count differ from proposed lexical ME meaning, but their allocation to one batch and units remains interpretive.
numeric_experiment.novelty: Exact multiplier-sensitivity computation is this run's analysis; underlying45-unit and fractional-nodulus arguments already published. Priority not established.
numeric_experiment.source_claim_actually_tested: Del Freo p58 says a distinct measure is difficult and quality/processing more likely, not categorically impossible. The code tests stronger arithmetic-exclusion inference.

yield_sensitivity.qualification: Positive missing quantities need more loss. Mere shared batch does not imply conservation across production.
yield_sensitivity.locator: p61 discusses raw-wool preparation losses in Mycenaean comparison; p62n49 distinguishes small spun-to-woven scraps and possible return of scraps.

claims.claim: ME cannot represent a different unit
HT24 establishes action delivers and identifies suppliers

claims.claim: Published comparison of A+KA versus JA+KA establishes shared designation
claims.counter: Shared weight unit and textile context constrain semantic domain without selecting synonymy versus different commodity categories.

claims.claim: Same batch requires equal input and output mass
claims.counter: Processing losses, additions or distinct conversion scales alter balance. Under acceptedME and multiplier2, 47.5surviving input can yield45output at18/19; lost input tightens threshold. No actual yield inferred.
